EntityCodexEntryDef.label: Ao Oni
EntityCodexEntryDef.description: A colossal blue demon that stalks the rim. Its victims become infected, and three days later become Oni themselves. All Oni variants share the same dread: the infection is incurable.

ResearchProjectDef.label: onionomy
ResearchProjectDef.description: A first survey of the Ao Oni. Studying this unlocks the entity codex page for the Ao Oni - only variants you have personally encountered will be catalogued.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ao Oni infection test
ResearchProjectDef.description: An entity study of the Ao Oni's infection mechanism. Surgical inspections can now reveal a hidden Oni infection or a doppelganger in the patient.

ResearchProjectDef.label: acceptance of the infected
ResearchProjectDef.description: A study of the colonists' hearts rather than of the Oni itself. The colony learns to accept the removal of the infected: banishing, executing or otherwise disposing of a colonist whose Oni infection has been confirmed by a surgical inspection causes no distress to anyone.

IncidentDef.label: oni attack
IncidentDef.letterText: An Oni has appeared and is hunting your colonists! Its wounds infect - anyone wounded by it will become an Oni in three days. Prepare to defend.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ao Oni cure
ResearchProjectDef.description: An advanced entity study of the Oni infection. Unlocks a surgical procedure that removes an Oni infection from a living patient before it fully takes hold. Industrial medicine or better is required - herbal medicine is not enough. Mechanoids can purge the infection by being repaired.

RecipeDef.label: Ao Oni cure
RecipeDef.description: An experimental surgical procedure that purges an Oni infection from a living patient. Industrial medicine or better is required; herbal medicine cannot provide what the procedure needs.
